positions.name: RollbackRehearsalAsPossession
positions.frame: what does it take for a rollback capability to actually be possessed by the organization — rationale, cadence, and ownership together?
positions.why: src-1 states the governing principle (an unrehearsed rollback is not actually had), src-2 fixes the cadence that operationalizes it, and src-3 names the owner accountable for it — together they read as one decision being formalized into a standing capability rather than three separate assertions. The conviction and value reads both mark this as decision-grade ratification with rehearsal treated as constitutive of possession, spanning all three segments as one coherent settling act.
